keyFindings.description: The INFRA-221 note this PR added calls the recipe above it 'still the step' and 'the clearest instance' of the line tools.md draws, summarising that line as 'about scope rather than about unpacking'. The recipe builds Postgres under literal /tmp (:37-39), which is not a mount in a role container (INFRA-44 note :53) and lost the harness twice in one morning (INFRA-43 :68); tools.md:84-91's first condition refuses it, and tools.md:182-186 cites this note as 'the illustration' of the test 'passed again'. Same class as round 7's finding 1: the location condition dropped from a hand-kept summary, here in a note marked status: active that a role follows.

The note says 'still the step' for a recipe whose <root> and <data> are unplaced (:30, :36-38), and gives as the reason only that the line is drawn 'by what a prefix leaves resolving'. A role that reads this note alone has nothing telling it the root goes on the issue's volume; the INFRA-43 and INFRA-44 notes carry the same one-condition paraphrase, true of their own recipes only because those recipes already place the root on the volume. Name both conditions, or point at tools.md's 'The test: where it lands, and what it leaves resolving' heading, in all four notes.

The test is stated once, under '### The test: where it lands, and what it leaves resolving' (tools.md:82); the pointers at :45-46, :395 and docs/kubernetes.md:176-181,195 name headings that exist.
